integrity: One original parameter-degree sign-transition theorem; the previously available fixed-parameter coefficient asymptotic is used as a proof lemma without independent novelty claims.
scientific_limitations: The degree threshold is asymptotic, not an exact formula for fixed degree.
Local uniqueness only in a fixed neighborhood of log 4 and only for sufficiently large degree.
The joint transition is uniform on compact rescaled-parameter intervals, not for unbounded perturbations.
The 2022 paper sharing the same quotient was accessed as a publisher preview, not full text; equivalent unindexed work remains possible.
title: First sign failure at an elliptic absolute-monotonicity endpoint
